name: pobo
description: Pobo Page Builder tools for Claude — AI styling of widgets to match your e-shop design, end-to-end design of a product description from a short brief, writing product, category and blog descriptions, checking finished descriptions and uploading them to the e-shop, catalogue-wide content checks with fixes, translation checks and fixes, product labeling from client-supplied lists (EANs, codes, URLs, names), product status confirmation (draft/ready), management and testing of AI generation prompts, scheduled nightly description automation, diagnostics for generated descriptions, and bulk editing of white label entity content with full undo, through the Pobo MCP servers (merchant tools plus a separate white label server).
